name: SupplierPoCollaboration
tagline: Supplier portal PO confirmation, partial ship dates and ASN builder with SSCC labels.
description: A Power Platform code component that lets suppliers accept, change or reject purchase order lines, split them into partial deliveries, flag discrepancies against price/date/quantity tolerances and build advance shipping notices with packages, SSCC-18 numbers and lot numbers — in Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
features: PO inbox with KPIs, search, filters and status chips
Accept / change / reject per line with reason codes
Price, quantity and date tolerance discrepancy engine
ASN builder with packages, SSCC-18 check digit and lot/heat numbers
Over-ship tolerance validation and ASN history with cancel
Draft, submit and revise with confirmation dialog
Phone list-detail layout with sticky actions
Configurable labels, colours, reason codes, package types and carriers
